# Termination Conditions

## 5.2 Obligations of the student

The School may terminate the agreement if the student violates the code of discipline and fails to meet the minimum academic requirements.

## 7.1 Termination by the parent

The parent may terminate the agreement if the family relocates or the student's health prevents attendance.
